items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] That's sort of like Bach when he was writing a new cantata every week... [INTERVIEWEE] Sure.

ctx.x: you wouldn't have the time to, you know, write out a real part, plus the fact that they weren't paying you for copyists copies during those days, and one of those things, so you had to find a short cut. And this was it.
That's sort of like Bach when he was writing a new cantata every week, you know, he had to borrow from other composers and other of his own music, and everything else.
